title: Current Criteria for Phase Separation in Driven Systems
exact_target: Relate macroscopic phase separation and traffic jams to how stationary currents depend on domain length.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000775 (OWR-1544-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Phase Transitions (2007), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2007/28, pp. 1575--1650; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 46--47, printed pages 1620--1621.

status_qualification: The report describes a proposed correspondence and quantitative criterion in selected models. It does not define one class covering every driven system or prove necessity and sufficiency without assumptions; those choices cannot be invented from this programmatic extract.
